resources.string: Add buttons to the notification panel
Floating button is OFF. Press the button above to turn it on.
Microphone permission was denied — recording will not work.

How it works: 
1. Paste your Groq API key (free at console.groq.com) 
2. Press “Show floating button” and allow the permissions it asks for 
3. A white circle with a black box appears on your screen — drag it anywhere 
4. Tap it to record (the box turns red), tap again to stop (turns blue while working) 
5. When it turns back to black, the text is copied — just tap and paste it where you want 
6. For even faster use, press “Add buttons to the notification panel”, then swipe down from the top of the screen, press the pencil icon and drag the Promptly buttons in — one records, the other shows or hides the floating button
